design: 6-fold cluster partition: member j validated on fold j, trained on the other folds; best validation epoch kept (patience 80, 2000 epochs trained); honest out-of-fold predictions from separate audit members

refresh_config._readme: The one place for the settings of the refresh pipeline (pull -> bin -> cluster -> splits -> bake-off). The scripts read it; an environment variable of the same purpose overrides it for one run (see each script's header). Changing a value changes the results: record it (the bake-off writes this file's content into its output folder).
refresh_config._control_note: control = the deployed model: the reference of the Bonferroni-Dunn / Wilcoxon comparisons (ProtT5: the best embedding on the 2026_03 release, and it needs only sequence)
